about: The provenance ledger (2026-11-17). Read by scripts/figure_provenance.py --verify (scripts/check.sh --fast). Every tracked file gets the class of the first rule whose glob matches; the classes and what each requires are in the script's docstring. `checked` lists sentences of current files whose figures a named test reads against live (tests/invariants) or against the constant in the code (`param`).

rules.note: Chapter edit lists and briefings: the manuscript text itself, out of scope (Kelvin's brief, 2026-11-17).
Its sections are pinned verbatim in the published snapshot, which --verify compares to live.
An attestation: tests/test_demo_rehearsal.py fails when the hashed files change (whole suite, check.sh --full).

rules.why_no_verifier: Preview files for the demonstration path (CLAUDE.md hard rule 2, arrangement 1); served only with placeholder_source demo; never a result.
